units: viewBox user units; rotate each <g id> about its pivot (transform-box: view-box)

notes.order: pinch-root > tail, legs, body (antenna-l/r, torso, belly, blush, eye-l > lid-l, eye-r > lid-r, mouth), arm-l > claw-l > jaw-l-bottom, jaw-l-top, arm-r > claw-r > lens, jaw-r-bottom, jaw-r-top; sparkle, sweat
notes.angles: degrees, clockwise positive (SVG rotate); pose files use exactly these pivots
notes.jaws: 0 = relaxed gap; shut: jaw-l-top +8, jaw-l-bottom -8; open wide: -12 / +12; the right claw is mirrored, so flip both signs
notes.lids: eyeOpen 1 -> 0: translate lid-* down 0 -> 15.5; brow angle: rotate lid-* about the eye centre (side-eye +-9, kind -+17)
notes.look: translate eye-* by lookX*3.5, lookY*2.5 (lids ride along)
notes.lens: child of claw-r; camera on = opacity 1 on #lens-glow and #lens-lit; #lens-view holds the magnified eye when the glass covers one
notes.outline: CSS vars: --pinch-outline (#365900 on light, #8FD400 rim or transparent on dark), --pinch-ow (3 at >=96px, 3.6 at 56, 5.5 at 28)
